notes.title: Game Update! v.12.5
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/ab9b77a06e65a3463e535019daa4a2c54c30eddd.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I’d like to share that I just updated the game to the [b]latest version[/b] (12.5).[/p][p][/p][p]In this version I added the complete story of [b]Neeva! [/b]She's part of a cute wrestleteam who've been training for months- hoping to win the upcoming championship. But when the team discovers keens poor physical condition, they can't look away- and offer to get him back in shape. ...And soon one thing will lead to the next![/p][p][/p][p]For this update I tried to add a bit of extra comedy to the story - and made [b]a dozen small animations[/b] to bring keens trainings sessions to life. I hope you will enjoy it![/p][p][/p][p]Well have fun playing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/07424b1d3d0b7a66440f6f6db4a7119c47847d8a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]This has been added (in more detail)[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]New Location: HOLO VR Hallway (3 variations)[/p][/*][*][p]New scene: Turn on the Radio![/p][/*][*][p]New scene: Training with Neeva (3 parts )[/p][/*][*][p]New scene: Finding the right motivation[/p][/*][*][p]New scene: The oil[/p][/*][*][p]New scene: The fangirl[/p][/*][*][p]Updated scenes: Tonda in the Hallway & Choose your wrestler.[/p][/*][*][p]New minigame: The [b]treadmill run[/b] (This was fun to make!)[/p][/*][*][p]XXX scene: an extra long scene for Neeva, with different endings (3 parts).[/p][/*][*][p]Other additions:  I added lots of new poses & animations for Keen and the wrestlers.[/p][/*][*][p]I also fixed the spelling errors & bugs you found, thanks![/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Good to know...[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]If you just want to see the new content,  you can best start playing from [b]Wrestle story.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Generally, when someone tells you to come back later; [b]pass through keens room.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]And please don't forget ...(for returning players)[/b]
[/p][list][*][p]Old [b]save games cannot be re-used[/b] after an update & will get you stuck if you do; because if code changes, saves break.[/p][/*][*][p]You can instead use the chapter select screen to get back to where you were (also, hold down [i]ctrl[/i] to speed up text).[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Walkthrough[/b]

Are you stuck, then maybe the [url="https://spacerescuecodepink.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/walkthrough_srcp_12-5_may_2025.pdf"]walkthrough[/url] can help? You can also find it again in the sidebar of the store-page, by clicking on the ‘ manual ’.

[/p][p][b]Behind the scenes[/b][/p][p][/p][p]And like always, I also love to show you a bit of how I actually make Space Rescue.[/p][p][/p][p]Now one of the things I worked on, was a [b]treadmill-mini-game[/b]. The idea here is that you simply 'step', whenever a footprint gets beneath your shoe. And if you do it without tripping too much, you'll win the game. 

Now visually I really wanted to use this perspective for the mini-game. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/606f0c8f7d3f101172ae8d5becf46db6ad4750a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]I liked this because it would  show [b]some depth[/b] in the  holographic screen. But the fact that you as the player are not aligned with the screen, just  felt too weird.  So in the end I went again with the simpler, frontal perspecivive. And this actually works great for the gameplay :)  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/2fdfbd168903a21e374285cae7f0d3a47cc87175.gif"][/img]
These are just sketches of course, but I hope you'll enjoy the final mini-game!

[b]Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]And that's all the news I have for now. But meanwhile I already started working on the next update, which I hope to release again in few months (You'll find the new release dates in FAQ).[/p][p][/p][p]Well, please enjoy this update & all the best![/p][p][/p][p]Robin[/p]

notes.title: Game Update! v.12.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/ab9b77a06e65a3463e535019daa4a2c54c30eddd.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

I’d like to share that I just updated the game to the [b]latest version[/b] (12.0).

And in this update I added the story of a [b]Biker girl[/b] who is seeking shelter aboard the Green Beetle. She's trouble, even for Keen. But by helping her out she will eventually open up-...and show a totally different side of herself :)

And as a little extra, I made the ships that arrive on the map, now also appear on the Bridge. So Keep an eye out for that as well.   

Well have fun playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/088fd2c09ab2c5c49cddca42e02a0261433eab9a.jpg[/img]

[b]This has been added (in more detail)[/b]

[list]
[*] New Location: Bike in Repairbay
[*] Updated Location: Bridge with a view on ships
[*] Updated Location: Shuttlelbay
[*] New scene: Bikers Arrival
[*] New scenes: Biker getting items
[*] New scene: The Tattoo
[*] New scene: The Arcade challenge, 3 rounds against Riyuka.
[*] New challenges: Find the tube, Find the cart ( it's been moved out of the maze).
[*] Updated Minigame:  The Arcade -Solar Queen
[*] Other additions:  Various items, a huge amount of additional story art & several small animations.
[*] I also fixed the spelling errors & bugs you found, thanks!
[/list]

[b]Good to know...[/b]

[list]
[*]     If you just want to see the new story-content, you can best start playing from the Bikers story.
[*]     Generally, when someone tells you to come back later; pass through keens room.
[/list]

[b]And please don't forget ...(for returning players)[/b]

[list]
[*]     Old save games cannot be re-used after an update & will get you stuck if you do; because if code changes, saves break.
[*]     You can instead use the chapter select screen to get back to where you were (also, hold down [i]ctrl[/i] to speed up text).
[/list]

[b]Walkthrough[/b]

Are you stuck, then maybe the [url=https://spacerescuecodepink.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/walkthrough_srcp_12-0_dec_2024.pdf]walkthrough[/url] can help? You can also find it again in the sidebar of the store-page, by clicking on the ‘ manual ’.

[b]Behind the scenes[/b]

And like always,  I also love to show you a bit of how I actually make Space Rescue. 

Now this update is about a biker girl, and what would a biker girl be without a bike right? So one of the first things I designed for this update was her bike. And here you can see my design proces for that. I hope you like the outcome! :) 

Step 1. Sketching

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/8f45bb83bbe175994766615a93e1907e17294e99.gif[/img]

Step 2. Refining

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/3f12a93517b6b724aace4946a9afaa4ab6f81495.gif[/img]


[b]Next?[/b]

And that's all the news I have for now. But meanwhile I already started working on the next update, which I hope to release again in few months (You'll find the new release dates in FAQ).

Well, please enjoy this update & all the best!

Robin

notes.title: Game Update! v 11.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/ab9b77a06e65a3463e535019daa4a2c54c30eddd.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

I’d like to share that I just updated the game to the latest version (11.5).

Now this time I added some extra content to various existing stories. And, I made a start with the [b]Captains story[/b]! Now the Captains story will be the final (and longest) story in the game, and it will reveal the bigger plot Space Rescue! Now I won't say to much about it, but I really hope you will enjoy it!

(Oh, and although this is the final story of the game- it's not the last one that I will add; there are still some sub-stories that need to be added as well).

Well have fun playing!


[b]This has been added (in more detail)[/b]

[list]
[*] New Location: The meeting room
[*] New Location: Leon's room
[*] Updated Location: Ready Room ( refined- new desk to match other bridge furniture)
[*] New scene: Taking down the stuff
[*] New scene: Discuss the findings at meeting table
[*] New challenges: Find the code, Find the ladder

[*] New XXX scene: 1 scene for the Doctor (added to the existing scene)
[*] Updated XXX scene: 1 scene for Lune in zero G (refined & trippeled no. animation frames.)

[*] New Minigame: Rosa's rope (Rosa's story)
[*] New Minigame: Cut the Roots (Sophie's story)
[*] New Minigame: Wrestle game (Tonda her story)

[*] Other additions:  Various items and additional story art & lots of small animations, like bouncing animations for Rosa's and the Capain! 
[*] I also fixed the spelling errors & bugs you found, thanks!
[/list]

[b]Good to know...[/b]

[list]
[*]     If you just want to see the new story-content, you can best start playing from the Captains story.
[*]     Generally, when someone tells you to come back later; pass through keens room.
[/list]

[b]And please don't forget ...(for returning players)[/b]

[list]
[*]     Old save games cannot  be re-used after an update & will get you stuck if you do; because if code changes, saves break.
[*]     You can us the chapter select screen to get back to where you were (hold ctrl to speed up text).
[/list]


[b]Walkthrough[/b]

Are you stuck, then maybe the [url=https://spacerescuecodepink.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/07/walkthrough_srcp_11-5_juli_2024.pdf]Walkthrough-Guide[/url] can help?

You can also find it again in the sidebar of the store-page, by clicking on the ‘ manual ’.


[b]Behind the scenes[/b]

Like always,  I want to show you a bit of how I actually make Space Rescue. 

Now as part of this update , I added the [b]Meeting Room[/b] to the game- because eventually a big scene will take place here.   And to make a room like this somewhat memorable,  I wondered;  how would a futuristic meeting room differ from the ones we have now? 

Of course I could add a flashy holographic map-projector, but that's  too fancy for Space Rescue right? Everything in this spaceship is a bit clunky and silly.  So I imagined the highlight in the room would be '[b]carousell chairs[/b]'.  which are chairs that roll out when people enter the room, and return if they leave. And the fun part is of course that they would get totally confused when there are more people then chairs :)  

And so then I ended up with this room design. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/93acccb7bde58e2de1964c05666a0d89674593da.gif[/img]

Well, I guess you are mainly here for the sexy content of the game- which I love to draw! But designing this odd old-fashioned, yet futuristic spaceship is a lot of fun too :) 


[b]Next?[/b]

And that's all the news I have for now. But meanwhile I already started working on the next update, which I hope to release again in few months (You'll find the new release dates in FAQ).

Well, please enjoy this update & all the best!

Robin

notes.title: Game Update! v.11.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/ab9b77a06e65a3463e535019daa4a2c54c30eddd.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

I’d like to share that I just updated the game to the latest version (11.0).

And this update adds the [b]complete story of  Watt-ii[/b]!  Now during this 'monster mystery' Keen's nerves will be truely tested as he decents into in the darkest part the ship... to make some challenging repairs. But perhaps not all is as it seems in this creepy story? 

Well I leave it up you to discover that,  
I hope you will like it!

[b]
This has been added (in more detail)[/b]

[list]
[*] New Location: The Brig ( 1 screen )
[*] New Location: The Cellar ; top,  stairs, middle, left & right ( 5 screens ).
[*] New Location: The Maintenance tunnels ; straight, left, right, gate, doors, dead ends ( 6 unique tunnel parts + variations together making 120 screens )
[*] New character: Watt-ii
[*] New scenes: Mysterious encounters 
[*] New scene: Keen falls
[*] New scene: Watt-ii's snack
[*] New music: Cellar & Maze
[*] New XXX scene: 1 scene for Watt-ii (containing 2 animation sequences)
[*] New challenge: Repair the Helping Hands
[*] Other additions:  Various items and additional story art & lots of small animations, such as moving doors, screens, character & effects animation. 
[*] And I also fixed the spelling errors you found, thanks!
[/list]

[b]Good to know...[/b]

[list]
[*] If you just want to see the new content,  you can best start playing from Watt-ii's story.
[*] Generally, when someone tells you to come back later; pass through keens room.
[/list]

[b]And please don't forget ...(for returning players)[/b]
[list]
[*] Old save games [b]cannot[/b] be re-used after an update & will get you stuck if you do; because if code changes, saves break.
[*] Please use the chapter select screen instead, to get back to where you were.
[/list]

[b]Walkthrough[/b]

Are you stuck, then maybe the [url=https://spacerescuecodepink.files.wordpress.com/2024/03/walkthrough_srcp_11-0_march_2024.pdf]Walkthrough-Guide [/url]can help?

You can also find it again in the sidebar of the store-page, by clicking on the ‘ manual ’.

[b]Behind the scenes[/b]

Well, without spoiling anything of the story... this is a situation you will encouter in the newest part of the game.

And here I really tried to create a more spooky atmosphere - which is of course very different from the usually very bright and colorful scenes in the game. Now to do this, I first made the 6 animation frames for this broken robot-hand- and then placed it in a sort of neglected looking part of the ship. But that alone felt a bit boring, and so then I added the animated-fog in the forground... and finally, I made the blinking shadow effect for the background (by copying the background, making it lighter, and then cut out a part again, to create the shadow of the robot-hand). 
  
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/2509f2a70da30ebb6aa232e6d65cc764d6757e8b.gif[/img]

Well, this was really a fun scene to work on for me. And once I had this, I could then use the same effects for many more parts of the story. But...you'll probably see that soon enough :) 

[b]Next?
[/b]

And that's all the news I have for now. But meanwhile I already started working on the next update, which I hope to release again in few months (You'll find the new release dates in FAQ).

Well, please enjoy this update & all the best! 

Robin

notes.title: Trading Cards & More Information On The Next Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38930319/b331f255909ae360c573905b543789e9a79cf43c.png[/img]

Hello everyone, thank you so much for playing Space Rescue!

I’m Robin, the creator of the game. And with great pleasure, I’ve been reading all your comments, messages and reviews & I’m really glad you are enjoying the game so far! 

But, the game is far from done of course. And this probably leaves you with a few questions- so, I’d like to use this news feed to keep you a bit up to date  with my plans for the future.

First off- while it might not be a content update, we do have something new in store- Steam trading cards! As of the start of the Summer Sale, trading cards have been enabled! Play the game, collect the cards, get cool rewards like Space Rescue themed backgrounds!

[b]As far as the next game update is concerned-[/b]

Well, many of you have been asking about game updates. So, let's start there.

The next update should be here within the next 2 months; and this means Keen will end up in even more awkward situations!

This time Keen will be sent to a new ship, called the 'Junkyard', where he will meet a master-mechanic named Valerie & where you get to play a new mini game.
Keen will also be helping out Lorza a lot more, while discovering  a whole different side of this alien masseuse...
And finally Keen needs to make a choice in who to rescue first from the pool, [b]Mindy or Sandy?[/b]

Well, I hope you like what’s coming.

[b]Final game[/b]
Now another popular question was, when will the game be done?

Well my goal is to have about 10 story-lines in the game. After I’m done with that,  I could still add some bonus quests for Keen, but these 10 story-lines complete the overall story of the game.

However,  It’s hard to put a date on when the game could be finished. So far I've been developing this game pretty much by myself.  But thanks to all the enthusiasm around the game,  I’ll soon be  able to get some real help on board! Like an experienced  programmer; ..which is not me. So alone it would probably take me another 2 years to complete this game, but the extra help should really speed up the production process, which is great of course!

Well, I hope this answers some of your initial questions about the game.

If you like to know more, please have a look at the [b]FAQ[/b], which is pinned in the discussion section. Or leave your questions here & I’ll answer those the best I can.

Well thank you again for Playing Space Rescue & see you around!

All the best, Robin.
